verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of a Git forge, so this story applies to Gitea. The evidence shows no assistant inside the product that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server (gitea-mcp) and the tea CLI let external agents and tools reach Gitea, but they are adjacent building blocks, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
